recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7815 unless Pharmacy later reopens the broader v2 dosage timing mapping policy.
issue_request: FHIR-7815 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the 2015 DSTU QA process asking to replace the MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction/scheduled[x] v2 mapping RDS:TQ1 with TQ1-X / ORC Quantity/timing.
initial_application: Commit 651364cb098a623c36afc1d6b9d56578507d897c explicitly listed tracker item 7815 and changed the then-active MedicationOrder.dosageInstruction.timing mapping from RDS:TQ1 to TQ1-X / ORC Quantity/timing.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription was renamed to MedicationOrder and later became current MedicationRequest. A later dosage refactor moved the timing mapping from resource-local dosageInstruction rows into shared Dosage/DosageInstruction datatype source. source/fhir.ini keeps both dosage and medicationrequest active in the current build.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction uses DosageDetails, DosageDetails.step.component is Dosage, and current Dosage.timing maps to TQ1-X / ORC Quantity/timing. Exact source checks found no RDS:TQ1 occurrence.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same 2015 v2 mapping update commit, but it concerns a neighboring mapping and was not needed to decide this seed.
